headline: Jormuntide Ignis: the best non-legendary Pal
title: Why Jormuntide Ignis Is So Good in Palworld | Best Non Legendary Pal | Palworld Guide
video_script: Want a top tier Pal without hunting legendaries? Get Jormuntide Ignis! Guides rank it as the strongest non legendary attacker in Palworld one point zero, right up there with the best. It's also much easier to breed than the raid Pals. And at your base, it has level seven Kindling, so it can power your furnaces and kitchens too. A fighter and a worker in one Pal. Do you have Jormuntide Ignis? Comment below!
description: Jormuntide Ignis in Palworld 1.0: the strongest non-legendary attacker, easier to breed than raid Pals, and a level 7 Kindling worker at your base.
